thread:
alex: Kicking off sequenced region rollout for v1.23.0 — order: US -> EU -> APAC. Planned change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. deploy-bot started canary in US at 02:05 UTC. cc @maya @simon :eyes:

deploy-bot: [log] started canary slice: us-central-1, instances=12, traffic=1% -> will ramp if smoke passes. rollout_id=rl-2026-3912

maya: Confirming warm pools are primed in US and EU. US warm pool: 14 GPUs idle after warmup. EU warm pool: 8 GPUs idle (still finishing kernel cache). APAC warm pool not primed yet (scheduled pre-warm at 02:45 UTC).

simon: Quick ask on rollback triggers — proposing: latency p95 > 350ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error-rate spike > 1.5% absolute. If triggered in EU, we pin EU to v1.22.9 and hold APAC. Thoughts?

alex: Agree on thresholds, add token-quality regression alert: perplexity increase > 6% on golden promptset. If any of the three triggers fire, rollback EU to pinned v1.22.9 and stop APAC.

li: Canary smoke tests running now — small sample generation ok but noticed tokenizer mismatch warnings in EU canary logs: `WARN tokenizer - unknown bytes sequence at pos 128` (only 3 warnings so far). Will watch.

maya: Metrics snapshot (query):
```
# Grafana short query
avg(latency_ms{region=~"us|eu"}) by (region) over 5m
US -> p50 42, p95 128
EU -> p50 58, p95 190
error_rate total -> US 0.18%, EU 0.22%
```
All within expected. APAC not started.

oncall-bot: Reminder — release window falls within maintenance calendar: change window approved (ID: CHG-2026-142). Pager rotation: ops-oncall currently: simon.

simon: Seeing a small steady climb in EU memory working set during canary, +6% over 10m. Not critical yet but I want a holdpoint at EU->APAC handoff. Set the deploy-bot to pause for manual go/no-go after EU 10% traffic ramp.

alex: Done — added holdpoint. deploy-bot, please stop before APAC ramp and notify thread.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint inserted: after EU traffic=10% ramp complete. Will pause and post status.

li: Running the regression eval on golden prompts for EU canary now. ETA ~7m. I'll post scores.

maya: Small ops note — dedicated pool autoscaler set to conservative for EU for next 30m to avoid noisy scale events. If we need more room, we can manually add 4 GPUs.

li: Eval results: token-quality delta = +1.8% (within threshold). No generation failures in sample of 200.

simon: Given telemetry and evals, I'm +1 to proceed. But if tokenizer warnings increase > 0.5% of responses, we abort EU ramp and pin.

alex: Go from me for EU ramp to 10% and hold. APAC remains blocked until manual OK. deploy-bot, execute. :rocket:

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 10% started at 02:28 UTC. Current EU traffic=10.0%. Pausing at holdpoint.

deploy-bot: [notify] paused at holdpoint — awaiting manual confirmation in thread.

simon: Manual confirmation: go ahead for EU -> 30% ramp if next 10m latency stable. I'll monitor.

maya: I'll keep an eye on warm pool temps and kernel cache hits — will call abort if any thermal or OOM signs.

alex: Final notes for runbook: add rollback command snippet (for ops runbook):
```
# rollback EU to pinned v1.22.9
deploy-bot rollback --region eu --version v1.22.9 --reason "latency/error/regression-trigger"
```
Keep channel open; I'll post final APAC decision once EU clear for 30 -> 100%.

last: alex: (closing) EU holdpoint cleared at 02:39 UTC, metrics stable. Proceeding to staged APAC warmup at 02:45 UTC pending APAC priming.
